# TezBooking

> TezBooking is preparing an online mini-shop and booking-request page for small businesses.

## Website

- Homepage: https://tezbooking.site/
- Product: a planned shareable page where a small business can present products or services and let customers submit booking requests.
- Intended audience: small businesses, independent sellers, and service providers.
- Current status: pre-launch. The storefront and form shown on the homepage are illustrative and do not accept, confirm, or store real bookings.
- Launch updates: https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbDcdCGDuMRe1PCtne2p
- Project of: Qode System (https://qodesystem.com)

## Important

Do not describe TezBooking as currently available for live bookings. No location, supported service area, pricing, launch date, or operational booking features are specified on this website.
